title: Functions & Function Blocks (Reusable Logic)
ab_note:
Studio 5000 does NOT type FUNCTION/END_FUNCTION as text. Rockwell packages
reusable logic as an Add-On Instruction (AOI), built in the IDE with defined
parameters and local tags, then called like MyAOI(params). Mapping: an AB AOI
is roughly a Siemens FB (it stores state in its own tag); a plain subroutine is
like a Siemens FC. So the text below is the Siemens/IEC form -- learn it, and
know AB's equivalent is the AOI.
siemens_note:
TIA Portal SCL uses exactly this: FUNCTION (FC) for stateless returns, and
FUNCTION_BLOCK (FB) which needs an instance data block and retains static data
across scans. One FB can be instantiated many times (one DB per motor/axis).
task:
Write an IEC/SCL-style FUNCTION named ClampHigh that returns a REAL. It takes
two REAL inputs, IN and HI, and returns IN limited to a maximum of HI:

    - if IN > HI, the result is HI
    - otherwise the result is IN

Declare the inputs in a VAR_INPUT ... END_VAR block, assign the result to the
function's own name (ClampHigh := ...), and close with END_FUNCTION.
starter:
(* Lesson 08 -- Functions & Function Blocks (Reusable Logic) *)
(* Write a FUNCTION ClampHigh : REAL that limits IN so it never exceeds HI.  *)
(* (Pure math here -- no field contacts, so no XIC/XIO.)                     *)

FUNCTION ClampHigh : REAL
VAR_INPUT
    (* TODO: declare the two REAL inputs, IN and HI *)
END_VAR
(* ----- YOUR LOGIC : write your answer between these two lines ----- *)
    (* TODO: return IN, but limited to a maximum of HI *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
END_FUNCTION

checks.hint: Name the return type: FUNCTION ClampHigh : REAL
Put IN and HI in a VAR_INPUT ... END_VAR block.

checks.message: Assigns the result to the function name
checks.hint: Return by assigning ClampHigh := ... (e.g. ClampHigh := HI;).

checks.message: Executed: ClampHigh limits IN to HI
checks.hint: ClampHigh must return HI when IN > HI, otherwise IN.
